svg.aria-label: A deploy, on your laptop or in GitHub Actions, holds the passphrase ALCHEMY_STATE_PASSPHRASE and seals each secret before it leaves the run. In your GitHub repository, the deploy takes the lock on the branch alchemy-state-store-lock, then reads and commits the state on the branch alchemy-state-store: one JSON file for each resource. The branch main holds your code and alchemy.run.ts.
